{{nihongo|'''Kamikoso Shrine'''|上許曾神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Ōmi Province]].

'''Kamikoso Shrine''' (かみこそじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} enshrined in {{ill|Nagahama, Shiga|Q844130|qid=Q844130}}, {{ill|Shiga Prefecture|Q131358|qid=Q131358}}.

=== History ===
It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} said to have been {{ill|Cuy|Q1146687|qid=Q1146687}}-enshrined by {{ill|Sangi (Japan)|Q1133663|qid=Q1133663}} {{ill|Tachibana no Naramaro|Q7673717|qid=Q7673717}} in {{ill|789|Q31558|qid=Q31558}} (Enryaku 8). There is a record that in {{ill|851|Q29966|qid=Q29966}} (Ninju 1), it was granted Senior Sixth Rank. In the {{ill|Jishō|Q1194671|qid=Q1194671}} era (1177-1181), four deities were enshrined in the {{ill|Aidono|Q135009883|qid=Q135009883}}. In {{ill|1876|Q7766|qid=Q7766}} (Meiji 9), it was ranked as a {{ill|Son-sha|ja|村社|qid=Q134917284}}, and in Meiji 15 it was promoted to {{ill|Gō-sha|Q134917316|qid=Q134917316}}.
